description: This file contains unit tests for the InvokeCommandRegistry class, verifying command and capability advertisement based on feature flags and support detection. It defines various tests to ensure the registration of commands and capabilities aligns with app feature toggles and supported commands, especially for Android app components related to device capabilities.

classes.name: InvokeCommandRegistryTest
classes.description: A test suite verifying command and capability registration logic based on feature flags and command support detection.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Verifies advertised capabilities do not include optional features when they are disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesFeatureCapabilitiesWhenEnabled
methods.description: Checks that optional capabilities are included when feature flags are enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_respectsFeatureAvailability
methods.description: Verifies that only supported core commands are advertised under default flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_includesFeatureCommandsWhenEnabled
methods.description: Checks that optional commands are advertised when feature flags for those features are enabled.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_onlyIncludesSupportedMotionCommands
methods.description: Ensures only supported motion commands are advertised based on feature flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_splitsSmsSendAndSearchAvailability
methods.description: Verifies that SMS send/search commands are advertised separately based on feature support.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includeSmsWhenEitherSmsPathIsAvailable
methods.description: Ensures SMS capability is advertised when either SMS read or send features are available.

methods.name: advertisedCommands_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Checks that call log commands are not advertised when call log feature is disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_excludesCallLogWhenUnavailable
methods.description: Verifies that call log capability is excluded when the feature is disabled.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities_includesVoiceWakeWithoutAdvertisingCommands
methods.description: Ensures voice wake capability is advertised without additional commands when enabled.

methods.name: find_returnsForegroundMetadataForCameraCommands
methods.description: Tests that command lookup correctly returns foreground requirement metadata for camera commands.

methods.name: find_returnsNullForUnknownCommand
methods.description: Verifies that unknown commands return null.

methods.name: defaultFlags
methods.description: Creates default feature flag settings for testing.

methods.name: assertContainsAll
methods.description: Helper to verify all expected commands/capabilities are present.

methods.name: assertMissingAll
methods.description: Helper to verify that certain commands/capabilities are absent.
